name: heat_pump_house_seasonal_power
title: Exercise: seasonal power of a heat pump for a house
summary: Teaching exercise 6.21. A Carnot heat pump meets the winter loss of a house, then runs at the same power as a refrigerator. The model computes the winter mechanical power and the summer outdoor temperature above 25 °C stored with that solution.
